stem:
Priya wants to measure her body temperature with a digital clinical thermometer at home in Jaipur.
Which set of steps is correct and safe?

options.text: Place the thermometer under her tongue, take the reading as soon as any number appears on the display, and wash the tip only if it looks dirty.
Reset the thermometer, wash the tip before use, place it under her tongue, wait for the beep, read the temperature, and wash the tip again after use.
Wash the tip, place the thermometer anywhere on the body such as the wrist, and read the number immediately after switching it on.
Reset the thermometer, place it under her tongue with her mouth open, and wash the whole thermometer including the digital display in water.

teacher.key_rationale: Correct digital thermometer use: reset, wash the tip before and after use, place under the tongue with mouth closed, and read only after the beep. Only option B contains all required hygiene and placement steps. A reads too early and makes cleaning optional; C uses wrong placement and instant reading; D keeps the mouth open and submerges the digital portion.
